notes: Adapted from the fork's single shared warlock preset (ui/warlock/apls/rotation.apl.json), which wowsims models as one package for all three specs. That preset's Shadow Bolt was a stale rank (25307 cast at rank 9; the build's current top rank for 25307 is 10) -- fixed here. It kept Amplify Curse as a prepull (buffs the next curse) which Affliction alone talents into, so it stays; Demonic Sacrifice was dropped since sacrificing the pet is a Demonology-tree talent Affliction does not have. Immolate was dropped as a maintained DoT (Destruction's signature, not Affliction's) in favor of Bane of Agony and Corruption, and Wrack (1316697) is added as a third maintained DoT -- Forever's own tier 6 Affliction capstone, a 6 second instant DoT the base wowsims/classic Affliction tree does not have. Forever's spellconst also carries a separate 'Curse of Agony' spell (18671/1233077) distinct from Bane of Agony (11713); which one Amplify Curse or a raid actually wants could not be confirmed from spellconst alone, so this default keeps Bane of Agony (the id the shared preset already cast) and flags the other as a concern for validation. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/.

priorityList.notes: Potion at the top of the fight if mana is already below 75 percent, or a mana gem below 60 percent, saved for the closing burn if the fight is nearly over.
Life Tap to keep casting once mana runs low; health is not a concern with three DoTs and Drain Life available.
Bane of Agony ramps up over its duration, so it goes down first and is refreshed on cooldown.
Corruption is the cheapest DoT per damage and is kept up throughout.
Wrack is Forever's Affliction capstone: a short instant DoT the base classic tree does not have.
Shadow Bolt fills every remaining global while the DoTs run their course.
